description: Reads contact imports. Without id it lists the workspace’s imports, newest first, one page at a time (a member sees those for their own numbers). With id it returns that import: its state (draft, queued, running, completed or failed), the file, columns, mapping and consent, progress, and when finished the number imported and the rows that failed with the reason for each. File contents come from outside this business and come back marked untrusted. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

name: list_contact_imports
title: See contact imports
